extraction_notes: Extracted exact tabulated catalyst-performance data from SI Table S7 and the beginning of SI Table S4. SI Table S3 is a literature-comparison table and was excluded per instructions, despite containing three 'This work' rows. SI Table S2 reports outlet gas compositions rather than conversion/selectivity/STY fields and was not converted into performance records. Plot-only figures (SI Figures S6, S7, S9, S11–S13) contain additional approximate data, but exact numerical values are not printed in the SI text; exact table values were used where available (SI Table S7).
